summary: This document describes protocol-independent methods that use a few marking bits in packet headers for performance measurement. The client and server cooperate by marking packets and possibly mirroring marks on the return path. They are especially valuable for protocols that encrypt transport headers, since they still allow loss and delay measurement.

eli5.summary: When the mail is sealed, helpers can't see inside. The sender and receiver agree to put small colored dots on the envelope so everyone can see how fast the mail travels.
